buildbyyou.baseUrl.description: Base URL for the xAI API.

buildbyyou.executorModel.description: Grok model used for coding and tool calling.

buildbyyou.imageModel.description: xAI image model used when the agent generates local project images.

buildbyyou.enablePlanner.description: Enable optional advanced planning for larger or more complex tasks.

buildbyyou.plannerModel.description: Model used for optional advanced planning.

buildbyyou.plannerEffort.description: Effort level for optional advanced planning.

buildbyyou.commandTimeoutMs.description: Timeout for local shell commands executed by the coding agent.

buildbyyou.maxRepairIterations.description: Maximum automated repair attempts per failing verification command.

buildbyyou.maxToolOutputChars.description: Maximum characters returned from a single non-file-read local tool invocation.

buildbyyou.requireApprovalForFileWrites.description: Require approval before file write, replace, or delete operations.

buildbyyou.requireApprovalForCommands.description: Require approval before shell commands are executed.

buildbyyou.autonomousCommandPolicy.description: When execution mode is autonomous, either auto-approve only safe commands or auto-approve all commands except blocked patterns.

buildbyyou.autonomousAllowedCommands.description: Exact commands that can auto-run in autonomous safe mode without another approval prompt.

buildbyyou.safeCommandPrefixes.description: Command prefixes treated as safe for autonomous auto-approval.

buildbyyou.blockedCommandPatterns.description: Regex-like patterns that are always blocked from command execution.

buildbyyou.autoStageApprovedChanges.description: Automatically stage approved file changes with git add -A when the workspace is a git repository.

buildbyyou.persistSensitiveHistory.description: Chat Memory. Persist raw chat history, recent chats, timeline details, terminal history, and task output locally in VS Code. Disabled by default to reduce local retention of sensitive data.

buildbyyou.taskPresets.description: Reusable task presets available through slash commands.

scripts.pretest: npm run compile-tests && npm run compile && npm run lint
